title.l1: A new story starts next week

head: MISSING
news.date: Last seen: Highway 9 gas station, 1:16 AM

lines.text: Leo didn't look up. He could see the man's shoes, right beside him.
Fill it up, Leo. Pump six.
Leo's legs moved on their own. He walked outside, into the rain.
Pump six was there now. Rusted. Its numbers spinning backwards.
In the morning, the station was empty. The register untouched.
And a missing poster was already taped to the window.
So if you ever see a pump six on Highway nine, don't stop.
